summary: Suburban Propane Partners, L.P. filed an 8-K (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) on April 22, 2026, furnishing a press release that announces the scheduling of its Fiscal 2026 Second Quarter Results Conference Call for May 7, 2026. The filing contains no disclosure of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, or other special-situation event. It is a routine operational update regarding an earnings call, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. The registrant is the issuer of common units trading on the NYSE under SPH. This is a standard earnings announcement, not a special-situation filing.
